rows.name: Delaware Health Care Commission
rows.mandate: Oversees Delaware's healthcare system, regulates health care spending, and guides health policy reform. Advises on insurance markets, health IT, and cost containment strategies.

rows.name: Delaware Health Information Network Advisory Board
rows.mandate: Governs Delaware's statewide health information exchange. Sets data policy, interoperability standards, and digital health strategy for Delaware's health IT infrastructure.

rows.name: Delaware Council on Persons with Disabilities
rows.mandate: Advises Delaware government on policies, programs, and services for the state's 220,000+ residents with disabilities. Advocates for accessibility, inclusion, and disability rights statewide.

rows.name: Statewide Independent Living Council of Delaware
rows.mandate: Oversees Delaware's Independent Living program under the federal Rehabilitation Act. Sets State Plan for Independent Living priorities and advocates for community integration.

rows.name: Delaware Commission on Housing
rows.mandate: Advises on Delaware's housing policy, affordable housing programs, and statewide housing data strategy. Guides federal HOME program allocation and state housing finance decisions.

rows.name: Delaware State Board of Education
rows.mandate: Sets K-12 education policy for 136,000 Delaware public school students. Establishes academic standards, accountability frameworks, and guides education technology and equity initiatives.

rows.name: Governor's Early Childhood Development Committee
rows.mandate: Coordinates Delaware's early childhood education strategy. Advises on PreK policy, federal CCDF compliance, and data systems for child care quality and access improvement.

rows.name: Delaware Commission on African American Affairs
rows.mandate: Advises Delaware government on policies affecting African American Delawareans. Researches equity issues, makes policy recommendations, and monitors state programs for racial inclusion.

rows.name: Delaware Hispanic Commission
rows.mandate: Advises Delaware government on programs and policies for the Hispanic and Latino community. Makes recommendations on language access, economic equity, education, and health services.

rows.name: Criminal Justice Council
rows.mandate: Coordinates Delaware's criminal justice system reform and data governance. Oversees federal justice grants, manages statewide criminal justice data systems, and advises on evidence-based policy.

rows.name: Natural Areas Advisory Council
rows.mandate: Advises Delaware's Natural Areas Program on land conservation priorities, natural area management, and ecological data systems. Reviews grant applications for land preservation funding.

rows.name: Violence Against Women Act Advisory Council
rows.mandate: Oversees Delaware's VAWA grant program implementation. Advises on services for domestic violence and sexual assault survivors, federal compliance, and data systems for program accountability.
